name: OCaml
description: OCaml compiled to native code by ocamlopt: strict, statically typed, with a fast generational garbage collector and an optimiser that does little inlining unless flambda is enabled.

variants.name: ocamlopt -O3 -unsafe
variants.description: Native code without bounds checks (-unsafe); -O3 only matters on flambda compilers.
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.o && cp {src}/main.ml {bin}.o/main.ml && cd {bin}.o && ocamlopt -O3 -unsafe -inline 200 -I +unix unix.cmxa main.ml -o {bin}

variants.name: ocamlopt
variants.description: Native code with bounds checking (the default).
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.o && cp {src}/main.ml {bin}.o/main.ml && cd {bin}.o && ocamlopt -I +unix unix.cmxa main.ml -o {bin}
